Class AddBugemonView

java.lang.Object
views.View<AddBugemonController>
views.AddBugemonView
public class AddBugemonView extends View<AddBugemonController>
View associated with the Add Bugemon screen.

This view manages the JavaFX components of the form, binds button actions to the controller, fills the choice boxes with the available options, and provides helper methods to read the values entered by the user.
